'''Darts D'Nar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] commander who served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Battle of Kiros]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was in command of the droid occupation of the planet Kiros. He was a slaver at the time, attempting to bring [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] back to its former might as a Slave Empire. The Zygyerrian Commander made a deal with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], to capture the Togruta population of Kiros, in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

Count Dooku accompanied him to the planet, and they soon started capturing the native Togrutas, and loading them onto their ships, while placing explosive charges around the city. By the time the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] arrived at [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], they soon realized that the whole population of the planet was missing. Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], at his request, soon met with him in the tower that he was hiding in to negotiate terms of surrender. They agreed to fight each other, hand to hand, with no weapons. D'nar easily beat Kenobi, pummeling him multiple times.
[[File:DNarPummelsKenobi-Kidnapped.jpg|thumb|left|220px|D'Nar pummels Kenobi in hand-to-hand combat]]
Meanwhile, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] began searching for the recently discovered bombs laid throughout the city. In a series of small clashes, Anakin and Ahsoka disarmed all of the bombs. This led to the eventual Republic victory, if only for a moment, as the slaver made his escape. He was then captured by Anakin and Ahsoka when they boarded his ship, the [[Tecora/Legends|''Tecora'']], by jumping off their [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]]. D'nar then unleashed one of his pets, a [[Blixus/Legends|Blixus]] on them. After Ahsoka wounded the creature, she went into the controls and stabilized the ship. D'nar drew his [[shock whip]] to fight the young Jedi, but he was subdued by her. After Anakin got rid of the [[Blixus/Legends|Blixus]], he questioned D'nar about the whereabouts of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists. After Anakin had his lightsaber at his throat, D'nar told him how [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|his queen]] was going to have a grand slave auction to bring back the Zygerrian slave empire. Afterwards, he and his ship were taken into custody by the Republic and he was presumably imprisoned at the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] while his ship was used by Anakin, Obi-Wan, Ahsoka, and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to infiltrate Zygerria.

==Behind the scenes==
D'Nar was voiced by [[Nick Jameson]], who also voiced [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars|''Star Wars: Clone Wars'' television series]].
